name: Toast
description: Bottom-anchored toast wrapper around ToastMessage for the React Native mobile app — auto-hides after `duration`, slides/fades in and out. Caller renders it inside a relatively-positioned container that fills the screen.
notes: Web uses Framer Motion (AnimatePresence + spring); ported to RN's built-in Animated.spring (supports the same stiffness/damping/mass physics config), no new dependency.
